title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10424)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard lays down guiding principles pertaining to the design and application of printed boards, irrespective of their methods of manufacture. However, it does not apply to the fabrication of components such as resistors, capacitors, inductors or transmission lines using these techniques.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Ready mixed paint, brushing, finishing, stoving for enamel color as required

electrical_and_safety_parameters: insulation resistance. This material is suitable for use up to 100°C
dimensional_tolerances: tolerances of plating thickness and of hole diameter. M
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
